one_liner: Google's AI research notebook; the Enterprise edition (now Gemini Notebook Enterprise) exposes a Pre-GA REST API on Google Cloud for managing notebooks, sources and audio overviews.
notes: Consumer NotebookLM has no public API; only NotebookLM Enterprise (renamed Gemini Notebook Enterprise) has one: discoveryengine.googleapis.com v1alpha projects.locations.notebooks (create/get/listRecentlyViewed/batchDelete/share) plus sources and audio-overview endpoints; no chat/query endpoint -> narrow. The API pages are marked Preview (Pre-GA). AUTH (ambiguous): docs require a licensed USER account and a Google OAuth 2.0 access token (gcloud auth print-access-token after gcloud auth login); service accounts are not documented and cannot hold a license, so I labeled oauth2 (Google OAuth user token) rather than other. A grader keying on 'Google Cloud auth -> other' would differ. ACCESS: the licensing page documents a self-serve free-trial tier (full-featured, 14 days, 5000 licenses) chosen in the Cloud console, then a paid monthly/annual subscription; so self_serve_trial, not paid_plan or contact_sales (sales only needed for more than 5000 licenses). Verdict ready because a self-serve trial path exists; main_blocker paid_plan records that sustained use needs paid per-user licenses. MCP search: checked Google Cloud's official remote-MCP Supported products list (docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products): no NotebookLM/Gemini Notebook entry (aiplatform /mcp/notebook is Colab Enterprise; discoveryengine /mcp is Agent Search); no Google-org repo found. Only third-party servers exist (jacob-bd/notebooklm-mcp-cli with experimental Enterprise support; PleasePrompto/notebooklm-mcp, archived Sept 2026, consumer browser automation) -> community.

evidence.quote: Signing in with your user credentials ensures that gcloud auth print-access-token generates an access token for your user account.
The projects.locations.notebooks REST API methods on this page require an authenticated user account with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license.
With this tier, you get a full-featured, 14-day trial subscription of 5000 licenses.
You can buy a monthly subscription or a year-long subscription.
Gemini Notebook Enterprise support is experimental.
Pre-GA features are available "as is" and might have limited support.
